script:
set -eu
set -- $1
clientport=$2
case "$clientport" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 2;; esac
iface=$(route -n get 192.168.1.246 | awk '/interface:/ {print $2}')
printf 'capture-interface=%s excluded-client-port=%s\n' "$iface" "$clientport"
exec /usr/bin/timeout 180 /usr/sbin/tcpdump -n -tttt -l -c 2000 -i "$iface" -s 128 "(((host 192.168.1.246 and tcp port 22) and not tcp port $clientport) or (host 192.168.1.1 and udp port 53 and udp[20:4] = 0x03323436))"
scope: bounded read-only passive packet summaries during separate N16 invocation; no lifecycle/config/workload action, payload dump or pcap
